# ReClip

> A free, self-hosted, open-source video and audio downloader with a clean web UI. Paste links from YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, Twitter/X, Reddit, Facebook, Vimeo, Twitch, and 1000+ other sites — download as MP4 video or MP3 audio.

ReClip is a lightweight Flask web frontend for yt-dlp. This deployment is hosted on Hugging Face Spaces.

**Note:** YouTube downloads do not work on this public deployment because YouTube blocks requests from datacenter IP addresses. For YouTube downloads, run ReClip locally (see source repository).

## Usage

1. Paste one or more video URLs into the input box.
2. Choose MP4 (video) or MP3 (audio).
3. Click Fetch to load video info.
4. Select quality and download.

## Supported Platforms

Anything yt-dlp supports — including TikTok, Instagram, Twitter/X, Reddit, Facebook, Vimeo, Twitch, Dailymotion, SoundCloud, Loom, Streamable, Pinterest, Tumblr, Threads, and LinkedIn.

## Source

- [GitHub fork (deployed version)](https://github.com/yagyaanshK/reclip)
- [Original project by averygan](https://github.com/averygan/reclip)
- [yt-dlp (download engine)](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp)
